results.title: Platform portal: login, navigation, tenants (create, suspend, restore, members, last-admin rule), SYSTEM_ADMIN grant / revoke

checks.name: login through the Platform portal lands inside /platform (not on the login or no-access page)
navigation lists Tổng quan, Công ty (tenant), Người dùng & Workspace, Nhật ký kiểm toán, Sức khỏe hệ thống — and nothing from the tenant-admin console
checks.detail: Tổng quan | Công ty (tenant) | Người dùng & Workspace | AI | Cảnh báo | Bảo mật | Chi phí | Connector | Sao lưu | Components | Templates | Nhật ký kiểm toán | Build & lưu trữ | Packages | Sức khỏe hệ thống | Cài đặt

checks.name: the tenant list is the REAL list (the DEFAULT tenant is there) and the section is not 'Chưa sẵn sàng'
an invalid form is refused in the dialog with both messages and NO request is sent
POST /admin/tenants → 201 and the page opens the new tenant
the server stored it: slug, name, ACTIVE
a duplicate slug is refused by the server (409 TENANT_SLUG_TAKEN)
suspend: the UI says so and the server agrees (SUSPENDED)
restore: back to ACTIVE on the server
add member as quản trị công ty: the server lists adminA as TENANT_ADMIN
the member row shows the person's NAME (resolved from /admin/users), not a bare id
demoting the ONLY TENANT_ADMIN is explained in words and nothing changed on the server
the server enforces it too (409 LAST_TENANT_ADMIN)
remove a plain member: gone from the active list on the server, the admin stays
grant SYSTEM_ADMIN to a fixture account: confirmed in a dialog, then the server says systemAdmin = true
revoke it: systemAdmin = false on the server
you cannot change your own SYSTEM_ADMIN right: the button is not offered on your own account
workspace page (SYSTEM_ADMIN): add by username → the server lists adminB as VIEWER of workspace A
…re-role to Biên tập viên then remove: gone on the server
the audit page lists the tenant events just made (TENANT_CREATED / TENANT_STATUS_CHANGED / TENANT_MEMBER_SET)
the system-health page loads without an error state
a workspace member with no platform scope is sent to /auth/no-access, never to a platform screen
cleanup: the tenant is marked DELETED
no unexpected 4xx/5xx from the portal's own calls (the deliberate refusals excepted)
no unhandled page errors

results.title: Admin portal, tenant admin: own company + members, no system-admin screens, rules explained, refused by the API as well

checks.name: [api] /auth/me of the tenant admin lists the tenant with role TENANT_ADMIN and is NOT platform scope
login through the Admin portal lands inside /admin (a tenant admin is NOT refused)
navigation = Tổng quan + Công ty của tôi (+ the sections still waiting for a backend); NO Người dùng, Nhật ký kiểm toán, AI…
checks.detail: Tổng quan | Công ty của tôi | Nhóm | Chia sẻ | AI riêng của công ty

checks.name: the landing page lists the tenant this person administers (no system overview, no 403 from /admin/overview)
Công ty của tôi shows the tenant, ACTIVE, with its member list from the API
the person's own row is named (from the session), marked 'bạn', and its role / remove controls are disabled (no self-change)
a tenant admin gets NO suspend / delete buttons (platform operations)
adding a person is explained, not hidden: this account cannot look people up (needs a workspace to administer / H-C1-11)

[api] …but allowed to read the members of THEIR tenant (TENANT_MEMBERS)
[api] …and refused to suspend it (platform only: 403)
[api] …and refused the members of another tenant (403/404, no list)
typing a system-only URL shows 'chỉ dành cho quản trị hệ thống' and makes NO call to /admin/users
Workspace của tôi: this account administers no workspace, so the page says so (no empty fake table)
a workspace viewer is sent to /auth/no-access by the Admin portal
cleanup: the fixture tenant is marked DELETED
no unhandled page errors
